articles.title: A T. rex named Gus just sold for $50 million — and it's as long as a school bus!
articles.summary: A giant T. rex skeleton named Gus sold for a record $50.1 million at an auction in New York. The fossil is 38 feet long and has 183 bones. Scientists hope the new owner will let them study it.

articles.title: The Orion pirates in Star Trek: Strange New Worlds are led by a funny mom from Diary of a Wimpy Kid!
articles.summary: In the new Star Trek episode, Orion pirates take over the Enterprise and turn the crew into puppets. The pirate captain is played by Rachael Harris, who was Greg's mom in Diary of a Wimpy Kid.

articles.title: Tennis shocker: World No. 1 Sabalenka loses to a 20-year-old ranked 35th!
articles.summary: Aryna Sabalenka, the world's top tennis player, lost to Sara Bejlek at the Cincinnati Open. Bejlek, only 20 and ranked 35th, came back twice to win. It's her first win over a top-10 player.
